ce.survey: BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey 2023 public-use microdata, Diary survey
ce.files: diary23/fmld231.csv to fmld234.csv (family), expd231.csv to expd234.csv (expenditure)
ce.unit: consumer unit (CU); BLS notes CUs do not match households exactly
ce.us_households_method: mean over the four quarterly fmld files of the summed FINLWT21 weights

us_households_crosscheck.source: BLS, Consumer expenditures in 2023, BLS Reports, Table A, row Number of consumer units (in thousands), 2023 column: 134,556

addressable_rule.buys_meat: BEEF + PORK + OTHMEAT + POULTRY + SEAFOOD + EGGS above 0 in the diary week; UCC prefixes 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08
addressable_rule.buys_packaged_food: MISCFOOD above 0 in the diary week; UCC prefix 18 (BLS miscellaneous foods: frozen prepared meals and other foods, canned and packaged soups, other canned and packaged prepared foods)
addressable_rule.window: one diary week, mirroring the 7-day recall of Task 5
